item.title: Tukaram Mundhe appointed Secretary of panel to overhaul MPSC; aspirants end agitation
item.description: Subsequently, Maharashtra Public Service Commission Chairman Vivek Bhimanwar announced that he had proceeded on leave till the inquiry was completed

item.title: CJI Surya Kant declines to meet INDIA bloc leaders on October 12 ‘with reasons’
item.description: Congress leaders Mallikarjun Kharge and Rahul Gandhi had written to the CJI and were scheduled to meet him between 4 p.m. and 5 p.m. on Monday (October 12, 2026).

item.title: Telangana to seek special financial package from Centre to tackle potential El Nino impact: Ponguleti
item.description: The Minister said the delegation to meet PM Modi would submit a representation seeking adequate financial assistance and additional workdays under the VB-G RAM G Scheme.

item.description: Punjab Congress in-charge and AICC General Secretary Sachin Pilot formally handed over the responsibility to Mr. Pargat

item.title: Get your own ticket confirmed first, Akhilesh Yadav tells Yogi Adityanath on Ayodhya challenge
item.description: Mr. Yadav spoke in Lucknow after paying floral tributes to socialist leader Jayaprakash Narayan

item.title: Community-led model to tackle drug abuse in 300 Haryana villages
item.description: The voluntary, non-political initiative has been launched by the Haryana Professional Forum and Jind Social Forum, a network of volunteers with roots in Haryana

item.title: Sporadic protests break uneasy calm in Delhi
item.description: Protests continue despite security deployment and restrictions on gatherings; throughout the day, police chase and detain demonstrators; a few shoppers return to Connaught Place but remain cautious

item.title: Kerala State Biodiversity Board submits policy document to mitigate threats due to invasive species
item.description: Document suggests laying emphasise on prevention and monitoring of the spread of invasive alien species and generating public awareness and capacity-building to handle the menace

item.title: Anti-CEC protest Highlights, October 11: CJI Surya Kant declines to meet INDIA bloc leaders; Delhi Police detain women protesters in the evening
item.description: CJP leaders to approach police seeking date to hold peaceful protest at Jantar Mantar

item.title: Hindu outfit backs its men arrested over Delhi assault
item.description: Hindu Raksha Dal chief Pinky Chaudhary claims the accused as his workers and vows to protect them; police probe allegations of inaction

item.title: Protests will happen not just in Delhi but whole country: CJP
item.description: Delhi Police officials took away their phones during their detention without issuing any seizure memo, CJP’s Saurav Das claims, raising concerns that the devices might have been hacked or cloned

item.title: Left parties say police turned Delhi into ‘war zone’; MP Brittas hospitalised after being detained
item.description: CPI(M) general secretary M.A. Baby accuses police of having ‘turned police vans into torture camps’, and alleges that ‘women are being cruelly attacked and detained for hours inside mobile jails’

item.title: Hyderabad man killed in Riyadh airport attack, two sons injured
item.description: The family was travelling to Madinah after performing Umrah when the attack occurred; the victim’s wife and daughter are safe, while his aunt sustained head injuries

item.title: Delhi Police releases video of informing Dipke about his grandmother's death, refutes CJP's allegation
item.description: Reacting to the police statement, Mr. Dipke said, “Why did you delete the part where I was asking for my phone so I could retrieve my cousin’s number? And where I was asking to let me speak to my lawyers?”

item.title: Two killed following gas exposure at ESL Steel plant in Jharkhand
item.description: An unfortunate incident involving gas exposure occurred in the plant in which an executive of the company and a business partner engineer lost their lives, said an ESL spokesperson

item.title: Rahul urges citizens to join INDIA bloc march to Supreme Court ‘as Indians’, irrespective of party affiliations
item.description: Congress chief accuses PM and HM of “imposing an undeclared emergency”; party leader K.C. Venugopal is coordinating with INDIA bloc parties regarding Monday’s march though the plan is not public yet

item.title: Four held in ₹37-lakh cheating case
item.description: The accused allegedly cheated the complainant, a native of Thiruvananthapuram, by promising returns up to five-fold on investment in a company exporting frozen food.

item.title: Chief Minister inaugurates IAP House
item.description: The IAP House, located behind the Kaloor metro station, will also be home to the ‘Arike’ Pain and Palliative Care Unit, which focusses on pediatric palliative care.

item.title: 450 kg of red sanders seized in Vellore; six persons held
item.description: Arrested persons were lodged at Central Prison in Vellore

item.title: Vijay urges Prime Minister Modi to sanction Metro Rail from Hosur to Bommasandra
item.description: The CM says the inter-State link will benefit both T.N. and Karnataka. He also urges Modi to reconsider Metro Rail projects in Coimbatore and Madurai in view of the future development and economic growth of T.N.’s western and southern regions

item.description: Forest officials said that a request was made to the District Collector by the Forest Department to remove accumulated wastes in the forest land along the path

item.title: 37 arrested in anti-drug combing drive in Kochi
item.description: Raids were conducted at 153 locations. The police seized 13.83 grams of suspected MDMA and 91.84 grams of suspected ganja during the raids.

item.title: Forum proposes draft Bill seeking protection for advocates, their kin, staff in Keralam
item.description: Keralam Advocates Protection Bill, 2021, seeks to protect them from assault, criminal force, intimidation and threats; it proposes a punishment of imprisonment up to five years and a fine of ₹1 lakh

item.title: Officials review arrangements for President’s visit on October 14
One-fourth of forms seeking Karnataka voter deletions not available on portal for public scrutiny
item.description: An October 9 statement from the Karnataka Chief Electoral Officer’s office says 1,10,654 Form 7 applications were received between June 16 and October 8; however, the official portal only showed 81,822 such applications; the CEO and the ECI have previously said details of all Form 7 applications would be made available for public scrutiny

item.title: PGRS cancelled on October 12 and 19 in NTR

item.description: Justices Anita Sumanth and Sunder Mohan, however, confirm his conviction for murder of a nine-year-old girl and modify the sentence to life imprisonment

item.title: 'Hung upside down, given electric shock': Three men allege torture at BJP MLA's house in Moradabad

item.title: Cultural performances, traditional dances mark start of Vijayawada Utsav 2.0

item.title: Indian died day after being injured in Riyadh airport attack
item.description: The Embassy in Riyadh said at least 10 Indians were among the more than 300 people injured in the attack

item.title: IIIT Ranchi student found dead in hostel, protest erupts on campus
item.description: Students alleged there was a lack of basic amenities at the institute; they also raised questions about the availability of emergency medical facilities, like ambulances and oxygen

item.title: Karnataka’s coffee cultivation area remains stagnant: KPA chairman
item.description: Indian coffee planters are struggling due to a lack of State subsidies, long-term low-cost capital for drip irrigation, and a shortage of climate-resilient varieties

item.title: Many detained near Shivaji Park as Mumbai Police prevent protest against CEC
item.description: Some allege that people merely standing or walking in the area were also taken into custody

item.title: Singing, acting, and beyond: Mano’s four-decade film sojourn in nutshell
item.description: It was music composer Ilaiyaraaja who gave him the name Mano and helped him achieve success; the singer has lent his voice to more than 27,000 songs, most of which are in Tamil and Telugu, and worked for composers ranging from K.V. Mahadevan and S. Rajeswara Rao to Anirudh Ravichander.

item.title: Anantha Nageswaran releases ‘white paper’ on AI, automation, and India’s workforce
item.description: According to the paper, the share of Indian employment exposed to artificial intelligence has risen modestly since 2012, and the quality of that exposure has improve

item.title: Mamata AITC MLA attacked; Abhishek Banerjee served police notice
item.description: Bibhas Sardar, MLA from Baruipur Purba in South 24 Parganas, was attacked on his way home in Joynagar

item.title: Toll in Manipur ethnic clashes rises to nine

item.title: Sixth POCSO Act case against ‘Gem Granite’ Veeramani

item.title: Keralam Assembly session begins on October 12, 2026
item.description: Session is expected to witness stormy confrontation between the ruling Congress-led United Democratic Front (UDF) and the Opposition Left Democratic Front (LDF).

item.title: Raja Ravi Varma’s paintings to travel for exhibitions: Vadodara royal Radhikaraje Gaekwad
item.description: Maharaja Fateh Singh Museum undergoes an expansion, a state-of-the-art new storage facility will be ready next year

item.title: The federal dilemma of delimitation
item.description: The Centre made an oral assurance while introducing the Bill to increase Lok Sabha seats that each State’s share would increase by 50% on a pro-rata basis. However, the increase could weaken the Rajya Sabha’s role as a check on the Lower House, while the Lok Sabha’s limited sitting days would leave MPs with less time to raise issues
